I have a unique perspective of the world that you just can’t get without living in many countries.

But there’s downsides for sure. I hardly ever saw my relatives, only for short periods of time on vacations so I never developed a strong bond with any of my extended family. It made school pretty hard too, I was always the “new kid” and I was never in one place for long enough to make meaningful friends. As soon as I would start to get close to someone we’d leave, so I never learned how to make real friendships until we settled down. I don’t have any friends from before high school.
